text: Vietnam Foodexpo 2026: a gateway for Vietnamese food to penetrate global supply chains
The Vietnam International Food Industry Exhibition 2026 (Vietnam Foodexpo 2026) officially opened in Ho Chi Minh City on November 11.

The four-day event sees participation from businesses across more than 20 domestic provinces and cities, alongside leading brands from over 20 countries and territories, including South Korea, Japan, Sweden, Russia, India, Malaysia, Australia, and Italy.

Notably, the South Korean pavilion is the largest, hosting nearly 80 businesses, followed by Japan with nearly 40 enterprises, along with strategic exhibition spaces from Sweden, Russia, and Malaysia.

Furthermore, the presence of over 100 Halal-certified businesses marks a strategic national move, opening wide doors for Vietnamese agricultural products and food to directly access the global Halal market, which comprises approximately 2 billion consumers in 112 countries.
Vietnam Foodexpo 2026 is not only a product showcase but also attracts a large network of international buyers from Canada, India, Indonesia, and other key markets seeking long-term supply partners.

Within the framework of the exhibition, several prominent specialized activities will take place, including the Vietnam Food Industry International Conference 2026 (Vietnam Food Forum 2026) focusing on promoting sustainable packaging and integrating Vietnamese food into EU supply chains, along with the 3rd Domestic Trade Development Policy Forum.

Coupled with a series of B2B trade connection activities between major domestic and international distribution, the event is expected to welcome over 25,000 specialized visitors, creating strong momentum for Vietnam's food industry to further expand its reach on the global food map.
